name: Christel Schaldemose - § 23 - Am 6
title: REPORT on the protection of minors online
part_text: 23. Encourages collaboration between the Member States that have already developed digital tools for effective age verification and the Commission, with a view to exchanging best practices and supporting voluntary interoperability, while stressing that the introduction and enforcement of age-verification systems fall exclusively within the competence of the Member States, particularly as such systems require societal acceptance and must reflect public discourse as well as the diverse positions of parents across the Member States;
